title: Internet in Bayfield, CO: Clearnetworx Fiber, Zito, Wireless
description: Internet in Bayfield, CO (81122): Clearnetworx fiber up to 2 Gig, Zito Media cable, CenturyLink DSL, local fixed wireless, 5G and satellite, from FCC data.
lead: Who serves Bayfield and the 81122 ZIP code, where fiber has reached, and what rural homes can get.
short_answer: Bayfield (81122) has Clearnetworx fiber at up to 2 Gbps both ways and Zito Media cable at up to 1 Gbps, each reaching a large part of the area in FCC data. CenturyLink DSL, AlignTec and Visionary Broadband fixed wireless, and Verizon 5G each reach most of the ZIP code. Satellite covers the rest.

sections.h2: The fastest options in Bayfield, ranked by top speed

sections.body_html:
Clearnetworx is a fiber provider headquartered in Montrose, Colorado, founded in 2012. It started a full fiber-to-the-home build in Bayfield in 2023. In November 2023, La Plata Electric Association announced it had sold its broadband company, FastTrack Communications, to Clearnetworx. The Durango Herald reported that Bayfield's fiber connection started in November 2023, that Bayfield has only one network connection from the south, and that a new route north toward Forest Lakes and Vallecito is meant to add a backup path.

Clearnetworx does not post prices on its Bayfield page. It says it has no contracts, no hidden fees and no pre-order fees. BroadbandNow reports Clearnetworx plans in Bayfield starting at $49.95 a month. In the June 2026 FCC data, its fiber reaches a large part of 81122, so check your address.

Zito Media's Bayfield page lists cable internet (not fiber) with speeds up to 1 Gig, depending on the address. The FCC data shows Zito cable up to 1 Gbps down and 25 Mbps up across a large part of 81122. Zito says plans and promotions vary by address and that equipment rental, taxes and fees may be extra. BroadbandNow reports Zito from $25 a month. Ask for the full monthly price, including equipment, and what it will be after any promotion.

sections.h2: Every provider reporting service in Bayfield (81122)

sections.body_html: Source: FCC Broadband Data Collection, June 30, 2026, matched to ZIP codes by YourBillCheck. Footprint compares each provider's reported locations with the widest land-based (wired or fixed wireless) provider near that ZIP code, so it is a guide, not a promise for your street.

sections.h2: Rural Bayfield: DSL, fixed wireless and satellite
sections.body_html: Outside the fiber and cable lines, most homes in 81122 have several choices in the FCC data. CenturyLink DSL reports up to 60 Mbps across most of the area; BroadbandNow reports it from $55 a month (see our CenturyLink bill guide). AlignTec is a small local provider; the Durango Herald reported it won a $593,000 state grant to bring fiber to the Deer Valley subdivision east of Bayfield, linked to a microwave feed. Visionary Broadband fixed wireless reports up to 100 Mbps across most of the ZIP code. Verizon 5G reports up to 300 Mbps across most of the area, and Starlink up to 280 Mbps with a clear sky view.

sections.h2: What to ask before you order
sections.body_html:
• Is my address live on Clearnetworx fiber, or still waiting on construction?
  • What is the price after any promotion, and is equipment extra?
  • For cable, DSL or wireless: what upload speed will I get?
